title: What happened in AI — Jul 19, 2026
intro: Two Chinese labs pushed open-weight models past the trillion-parameter mark today: Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 (2.4T params) claims near-frontier performance, and Moonshot's Kimi K3 landed with enough force to plunge AI-semiconductor stocks and reportedly speed up a Hong Kong IPO.

On the tooling side, Claude Code quietly moved to Bun's Rust port for a modest speed bump, Google's AlphaEvolve code-optimization system went GA, and defenders started firing prompt injection back at AI hacking agents.
highlights: Kimi K3's launch triggered an AI-semiconductor stock selloff and appears to be accelerating Moonshot's Hong Kong IPO.
Alibaba shipped Qwen 3.8 at 2.4T parameters claiming near-frontier performance, and Apple reportedly hired the original open-source Qwen team to fix Siri in China.
Claude Code now runs on Bun's Rust port, cutting Linux startup time about 10% with no other visible change.
Google's AlphaEvolve, DeepMind's evolutionary code-optimization system, reached general availability on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
Defenders are turning prompt injection back on AI hacking agents, while platform teams face pressure to serve environments at agent speed.

categories.name: Agent Runtimes & Coding Tools
categories.summary: Coding-agent internals and tooling moved today, from a low-level Claude Code rewrite to a new class of agent-specific recorders and code-optimization services.

articles.title: Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now

articles.title: Codex is technically better than Claude Code, but I stopped using it for one specific reason

articles.title: AI coding agents should optimize for less owned code
articles.summary: Argues coding agents should aim to minimize the code a team must maintain long-term, not just how fast they can generate more of it.

articles.title: Google's AlphaEvolve Reaches General Availability with Evolutionary Code Optimization as a Service
articles.summary: AlphaEvolve, DeepMind's evolutionary code-optimization research project, is now a general-availability service on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, with evaluators running client-side.

articles.title: Show HN: Flightwake – a flight recorder for AI coding agents, not a navigator
articles.summary: A new open-source tool logs and replays AI coding-agent sessions for postmortem debugging, positioning itself as a recorder rather than an autonomous pilot.

categories.name: Platform Engineering & Production Security
categories.summary: Two operational fronts for agent builders: provisioning ephemeral environments fast enough for agent workloads, and defending against prompt injection now that attackers are weaponizing it against AI hacking agents themselves.

articles.title: Platform engineering's new job: serving environments at agent speed
articles.summary: Platform teams are being asked to provision throwaway dev/test environments on agent-speed timelines, reframing environment-serving as a first-class platform-engineering job.

articles.title: Prompt Injection Attacks Are Thwarting AI Hacking Agents
articles.summary: Defenders are turning prompt injection back on offensive AI agents, using it to derail automated attack tools mid-run.

articles.title: How Netflix Built GenPage: a Single GenAI Model to Build Personalized Homepages
articles.summary: Netflix replaced its multi-stage homepage recommendation pipeline with GenPage, a single generative model that builds personalized homepages directly from user history and request context.
